dataset.arm_order: cyclic Latin square: rotation = repetition mod 4; each arm in each position 4x per D

split: per D chronological: first 8 blocks train, last 8 test

features.clrt: ACK -> complete response (Formby CLRT; the D contract's observable)

signature: Formby Eq.1: 199 equal bins on [0,H) + overflow bin (m >= H; Formby drops m == H, disclosed); H = 1.05 x max training value, training only
window_rule: same-operation, never crossing block or arm

classifiers.ff_ann: MLPClassifier one hidden layer; Formby random 75/25 split; hidden size by GroupKFold on training only
classifiers.gmm: unsupervised, full covariance, 3 components, window [mean, variance], Hungarian label matching

attackers: pre_deployment: trained on off, tested on each arm
metrics: Formby per-class accuracy/precision/recall: mean across classes and minimum class
balanced accuracy with 95% CI from 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of test blocks

claims_under_test.timing: contract response_ready_ack_d_no_j_v3: CLRT ~= D for every class in timed arms
claims_under_test.timing_falsifier: timed-arm per-class CLRT medians differ by more than the off-arm spread, or retrained CLRT classifier is not below off at the same D (paired bootstrap 95% CI)
claims_under_test.size: padded arms: every response equals its class image (READ 91->141, 134->158; SBO 49->60)
claims_under_test.size_falsifier: any padded response not equal to its class image, or any native size in a padded arm
claims_under_test.size_expected_limit: READ remains separable from SBO by construction; reported as the current transform's limit
claims_under_test.not_evaluated: paper RO2 single 61-byte size (historical software-outstation testbed)

sufficiency_gate.capture: 0 kernel drops; every planned exchange matched

overhead: request->response latency vs off (median, IQR, p95, max, mean+-std)
padding octets per response and per transaction
excluded: new classifiers on request->ACK or request->response
